text:
Maya: Uploaded updated Figma frames for the compact multi-canary row + legend. Please review the VoiceOver reading order and behavior on small screens: https://www.figma.com/file/XYZ/multi-canary-compact (frame: Legend Compact)
Priya: Quick pass: visually looks fine but VoiceOver announces 'Canary B, 20%' before the status pill (running/paused). That could confuse screen reader users because status is the primary state. Suggest semantic order change so status comes first in DOM.
Maya: Visual order must remain the same. Options: aria-label on the status pill or reorder DOM and use CSS to preserve visual layout. Any preferences?
Sam: If we change DOM order, make sure focus still lands on the variant row and not on the legend control — cheap to break rollback flow. Flag for QA.
Jordan: From implementation side, reordering DOM and using CSS order is straightforward and avoids relying on aria hacks. We can also add aria-describedby tying the row to the status element.
Priya: Recommend: keep status early in DOM, visually reorder with CSS (flex order) so assistive tech reads status first but sighted users see same layout. Add aria-describedby on the variant row pointing to the status id. Also ensure the status text is meaningful (not just an icon).
Luca: Implementation sketch:
.variant-row { display: flex; align-items: center; }
.status { order: 1; }
.legend { order: 2; }
And set aria-describedby="status-<id>" on the row.
Maya: Two additional issues: 1) on narrow widths legend chips wrap and push the rollback CTA down creating visual noise; 2) 'Paused' pill fails contrast target in dark theme (measured ~3.8:1).
Jordan: For wrap issue we can collapse extra chips into an overflow chip like '+2' that opens a popover. For contrast, will update token or swap to outlined pill variant in dark mode to hit >=4.5:1.
Sam: Prefer overflow to avoid vertical growth. Make sure overflow is keyboard accessible and that the rollback CTA remains visible without extra scrolling. We'll A/B copy on the CTA in the canary: current "Roll back" vs shorter "Revert" to see if conversion differs. Keep analytics event deploy.rollback.click with label copy_variant.
Priya: Accessibility checklist for overflow: it must be a focusable button with aria-expanded, visible focus ring, and the expanded list should expose roles (listbox/menu) depending on interaction. When collapsed, hidden items should be aria-hidden.
Luca: I'll add feature flag canary_legend_v2 and hook analytics flags for copy_variant.
deploy-bot: Staging build deployed: https://staging.redwood.ai/deploys/legend-v2
Maya: I'll push figma updates with DOM notes and a narrow-width frame and tag Priya once ready.
Priya: I'll review after the update. Quick final checklist for devs: 1) status element early in DOM; 2) visual order preserved via CSS; 3) overflow chip implemented as accessible button; 4) contrast >=4.5:1 for critical state pills; 5) analytics event includes copy variant metadata.
Sam: Plan: Jordan implements DOM/CSS this sprint, Luca wires analytics and overflow interactions, QA validates on staging next week, then we run the A/B copy canary.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Leaving the figma and staging links in the thread for follow-up.
